name: Returns a PDF for the given activity
description: Returns a PDF for the given activity
whenToUse: Download the historical PDF snapshot of the entity tied to one activity, identified by activity_id, when you need that point-in-time document.

queryParameters.name: include
queryParameters.description: Include child relations of the Activity object, format is comma separated. **Note** it is possible to chain multiple includes together, ie. include=account,token
